dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, interviewers often ask about your achievements. What have you achieved at work?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈɪntərvjuːərz ˈɔːfən ˈæsk əˈbaʊt jʊr əˈtʃiːvmənts. ˈwʌt hæv juː əˈtʃiːvd ət ˈwɜːrk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, at the restaurant, our manager gave us a sales target last year.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ət ðə ˈrɛstərɑːnt, aʊr ˈmænɪdʒər ˈɡeɪv ʌs ə ˈseɪlz ˈtɑːrɡɪt ˈlæst ˈjɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I suggested a cheap lunch menu for students, and we managed to increase sales by twenty percent.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪ səɡˈdʒɛstɪd ə ˈtʃiːp ˈlʌntʃ ˈmɛnjuː fər ˈstuːdənts, ənd wiː ˈmænɪdʒd tə ɪnˈkriːs ˈseɪlz baɪ ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's a great result. Did you succeed in anything else?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ə ˈɡreɪt rɪˈzʌlt. dɪd juː səkˈsiːd ɪn ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. We also succeeded in getting a lot of good online reviews.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. wiː ˈɔːlsoʊ səkˈsiːdɪd ɪn ˈɡɛtɪŋ ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈɡʊd ˈɑːnlaɪn rɪˈvjuːz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. Have you ever tried something that didn't work?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. hæv juː ˈɛvər ˈtraɪd ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæt ˈdɪdənt ˈwɜːrk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. For our university's charity run, we wanted to raise fifty thousand baht, but we only managed to raise thirty thousand.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. fər aʊr ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsətiz ˈtʃærəti ˌrʌn, wiː ˈwɑːntɪd tə ˈreɪz ˈfɪfti ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt, bʌt wiː ˈoʊnli ˈmænɪdʒd tə ˈreɪz ˈθɜːrti ˈθaʊzənd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's still a good result. What would you do differently next time?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈstɪl ə ˈɡʊd rɪˈzʌlt. ˈwʌt wʊd juː ˈduː ˈdɪfərəntli ˈnɛkst ˈtaɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'd start earlier and ask more people to join.
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈstɑːrt ˈɜːrliər ənd ˈæsk ˈmɔːr ˈpiːpəl tə ˈdʒɔɪn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Very good. Talk about results like that, and you'll do very well.
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ˈɡʊd. ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt rɪˈzʌlts ˈlaɪk ðæt, ənd juːl ˈduː ˈvɛri ˈwɛl.
